To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the 450K data processing is more complex than initially anticipated and (ii) the most popular normalization method, Infinium Human Methylation 450K BeadChip Array (HM450K) BeadChip Array Analysis Guide, does not provide the best performance in terms of technical and biological reproducibility.
the Illumina Infinium Methyaltion450 data processing is complex, but it is possible to obtain high quality data.

1) Infinium 450k methylation data are affected by batch effects that can be reduced by a proper normalization procedure; 2) the normalization procedure should be selected according to the type of experiment and the biological question; 3) normalization procedures that are based on the use of a reference sample should not be applied to the analysis of a single sample; and 4) a proper quality control procedure is essential to identify and discard low-quality samples.
